title: Cornell rainy north campus from bridge
author: Notyourbroom
description: Looking north toward Cornell University's North Campus, with Balch Hall visible in the background. Taken while standing on the Thurston Avenue Bridge in Ithaca, NY, on the Cornell University Campus. NB: This photograph was taken before the extensive renovations which expanded the bridge, widened the sidewalks, added bike lanes, &c.

title: Cornell Tech td (2019-11-03) 024
author: Tdorante10
description: Bicycle racks along East Loop Road at the north end (Phase 1) of the Cornell Tech campus, at East Loop Road and North Loop Road at approximately Manhattan 58th Street in the southern half of Roosevelt Island, Manhattan. The campus was constructed on the site of the Goldwater Memorial Hospital. This promenade-like road is similar to Center Boulevard in Hunters Point South.
